note: Closed table maintained by the content team (contract §13.6, §16.1): which craft-directive nodes of content/craft/text-graph.json the capsule's `style.directives` carries for each Director beat (at most 4 per beat), plus one English line for each of the nine style axes and the seventeen directives (the keeper carries them into the player's language; `language_applicability` on the text-graph nodes stays data). Every id must exist in the text graph; the kernel validates this at load and never judges prose to pick a line.

directive_lines.player-action-uptake: enact the declared action from the world's view
directive_lines.rewrite-abstract-explanation-to-action: inner states become action, voice, posture, gaze, evidence
directive_lines.skill-interpretation-after-visible-evide: skill judgement after the visible evidence
directive_lines.crisis-scene-clarity: in a crisis: space, force, risk, handles first
directive_lines.final-prose-guard-before-output: reread a hard draft for meaning first
directive_lines.repetition-policy: compress settled facts; enact the current action yourself
directive_lines.action-uptake-review: check the draft enacts the action, not the player's phrasing
directive_lines.final-output-pass: review only when the draft was hard
directive_lines.rewrite-ai-summary-voice: information via scene detail or NPC speech, not report voice
directive_lines.rewrite-expository-choice-summary: space, motion, risk, handles as scene, not option notes
directive_lines.rewrite-camera-direction-staging: one natural sentence names the person and the focus
directive_lines.rewrite-passive-translation-ese: active voice, clear subject, concrete action
directive_lines.rewrite-abstract-psychological-explanati: visible behaviour first; explain after evidence or a skill result
directive_lines.npc-direct-speech: an NPC giving news or a refusal speaks at least one line
directive_lines.scene-sensory-anchor: a new scene opens on one concrete sensory detail
directive_lines.spend-budget-on-scene-texture: spend length on texture, sound, space, motion, not events
